knobs.note: BH-9117 test seam: epoch seconds used as the clock. Only all-digit values are used. NOT settable from the control plane. The window, dry-run mode, rows-per-run and GitHub reads-per-run limits are settings rows (console.needs.max_age_days, console.needs.sweep_dry_run, console.needs.sweep_max_rows, console.needs.sweep_max_reads; transport bounds console.needs.sweep_page_size, console.needs.sweep_apply_chunk, console.needs.sweep_http_timeout_s) the script reads with setting_get, not lane knobs.
BH-9117 test seam: 1 = load the decision functions (ns_epoch, ns_rule, ns_decide) and return before the run. NOT settable from the control plane.

BH-9117: needs-sweep writes pr_closed only for a closure older than this window (mc_closed_settled), the same window reconcile-prs and merge-sweep use. A younger closure is kept as pr_unsettled and re-read on the next run. 0 turns the window off: every closure is treated as settled.
